title: Message Types
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
In the case of an error, the log of the service operation is filled with the corresponding error message.

Message Types

e CreditManagementAccountERPPaymentBehaviourSummaryByDebtorPartyQuery_sync

e CreditManagementAccountERPPaymentBehaviourSummaryByDebtorPartyResponse_sync

Notes on SAP Implementation

The PropertyValuation is filled with key figures from the system in which Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable is running.
Configuration

e Before you can use the service operation in Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA), you must activate the
integration with SAP Credit Management in Customizing forContract Accounts Receivable and Payable under Integration

> Financial Supply Chain Management -> Credit Management -> Activate Credit Management .

e If you want to transfer FI-CA key figures within the field PropertyValuation, you must activate the relevant key figures in
Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under Integration -> Financial Supply Chain Management ->
Credit Management -> Key Figures -> Make Specifications for Key Figures for Credit Management .

Enhancements

Enhancements

To enhance the proxy structure of the current operation, you can use event 4614 (see the documentation of sample function
module FKK_SAMPLE_4614).

You can create your own key figures and send them to the Credit Management system. For more information, see the Customizing
documentation under Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable -> Integration > Financial Supply Chain Management ->
Credit Management -> Key Figures -> Define Key Figures for Transfer to Credit Management .

Query Contract Account In

Definition

Request to contract account for provision of contract account data.

Technical Data

Entity Type               Service Interface
Category                  A2X

Direction         inbound
